traits.name: Greater Magic Resistance
traits.text: The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and the attack rolls of spells automat- ically miss it. Without the rakshasa’s permission, no spell can observe the rakshasa remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.text: If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points some- where in the Nine Hells. Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair). If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to suc- ceed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage. Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 56 (16d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. Adult Red Dragon
